title: Core prescribed overlap transition construction
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R a diagram of commutative rings, c its colimit cocone, i an index, and t:Z to Spec R_i finitely presented. Use shared derived categories on schemes and localized open sites [def-pc-derived-category]. For j greater than or equal to i put Yj=Z base changed to R_j, X=Z base changed to c.pt and let gj:X to Yj be the canonical map. Let compact opens U,V cover Yj, let A,B be perfect derived objects on these opens [def-pc-perfect-complex], and let phiU,phiV identify their derived pullbacks with the exact restrictions of E on X [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. There exist k greater than or equal to j, with canonical f:Yk to Yj and g:X to Yk, a coherent diagram d:SchemeTwoOpenComparisonDiagram X Yk g (f inverse U) (f inverse V) (gj inverse U) (gj inverse V) [def-pc-two-open-comparison-diagram], an isomorphism e:SU A' to SV B' where A',B' are the f-pullbacks of A,B, and isomorphisms thetaU:d.HU A' to RU E and thetaV:d.HV B' to RV E such that gammaU inverse at A' followed by SP(thetaU.hom) and tauU at E equals HW(e.hom) followed by gammaV inverse at B', SQ(thetaV.hom) and tauV at E. All restrictions and comparison maps are the exact ones fixed in the diagram structure. Only the local objects and their overlap equation occur; there is no quantification over a stage object or realizations. This is the core construction used before the target wrapper. The core theorem additionally assumes the stage-existence lemma: every pair of opens admits a later index. The wrapper supplies this by choosing the current index. In Lean this identical proposition is named perfectOverlapCoreStatement to cache parameter metadata; its explicit definition retains every quantifier, local binding and equation just described.

lean.statement:
theorem perfect_overlap_transition_comparison_core
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (Z : Scheme.{u}) (t : Z ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation t] [QuasiCompact t] [QuasiSeparated t]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hstage : ∀ (U V : (pullback t (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Opens),
      ∃ k : I, j ≤ k)
    : perfectOverlapCoreStatement R c hc i Z t j hij hstage
